title: Closed finite free ideal-product comparison
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-scheme], $K$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on $X$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and $r$ a natural number. There exists an isomorphism from $i_*((K\mathcal O_Z)^{\oplus r})$ to $K(i_*(\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}))$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk] whose composite with the ambient product inclusion equals the pushforward of the coordinate ideal inclusions. No Noetherianity is required.

source.place: Closed pushforward affine quotient calculation; extension to finite sums by tensor and pushforward coproduct comparisons.

proof.text: Apply the normalized rank-one closed structure ideal-product comparison. Factor tensor multiplication through its image and the inverse comparison, obtaining an epimorphism c from K tensor i_*O_Z onto i_*(K O_Z), whose composite with the ideal inclusion is multiplication.

Pushforward preserves finite coproducts because it is additive; tensorLeft preserves these coproducts by the proved tensor-Hom adjunction. Assemble c coordinatewise using the two coproduct comparison isomorphisms to obtain an epimorphism q onto i_*((K O_Z)^r). The natural ideal inclusion j is monic. On every coproduct coordinate, the comparison equations, whisker exchange and left-unitor naturality show q followed by j is multiplication on i_*(O_Z^r). The image of this epi-mono factorization gives the desired isomorphism and its inclusion equation. Empty finite sums, zero ideals and empty schemes are included.

proof_origin.based_on: Tag 01QY and the existing normalized rank-one comparison; finite-sum categorical assembly proved in Lean.

theorem closed_free_ideal_product_iso
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin r ↦ (K.comap i).toModules) ≅
        idealModuleProduct K.toModulesι
          ((pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)),
      e.hom ≫ idealModuleProductι K.toModulesι
          ((pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) =
        (pushforward i).map (Sigma.desc (fun j : Fin r ↦ (K.comap i).toModulesι ≫
          Sigma.ι (fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf) j))
